issues.title: test(vn-holidays): add tests/holidays.test.ts with edge cases beyond the golden fixtures
issues.body:
## Problem
`vn-holidays` has only `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts` (4 `it` blocks that iterate `tests/golden/vn-holidays.json`). Every other skill has a dedicated `tests/<name>.test.ts`, and CONTRIBUTING requires one. Behaviour that is not a pure input->output case is untested: error results for malformed dates, `announced: false` for years without data, `addWorkingDays` with n=0 or a negative n, and ranges that cross a year boundary.

## Acceptance
- [ ] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases covering: invalid date input (`ok: false` with code and hint), a year with no announcement (`announced: false`, statutory days only), weekend-collision compensation, `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [ ] Only assert behaviour the current implementation already has. If a case exposes a bug, report it in the PR instead of silently changing behaviour
- [ ] Do not edit `packages/core/data/*.json`
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass
issues.triage_reason: The holidays skill has no dedicated test file, unlike the other skills, and CONTRIBUTING requires >= 20 tests per skill.
issues.summary: Added tests/holidays.test.ts with 33 characterization tests (invalid input, unannounced year, weekend compensation, addWorkingDays n=0/negative, year boundary). No behaviour changes; no bugs found.
issues.pr_title: test(vn-holidays): add edge-case tests beyond golden fixtures
issues.pr_body:
## What & why

Closes #60

Adds `tests/holidays.test.ts` with 33 characterization tests for `vn-holidays`. Before this, the skill only had `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts`, which covers pure input/output cases. The new tests cover:

- invalid or malformed date input: `ok: false` with a code and a hint
- a year with no announcement: `announced: false`, statutory days only
- weekend-collision compensation
- `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n
- ranges that cross a year boundary

The tests assert only what the current implementation already does. No source code or data files changed, and no bugs were found.

Acceptance from the issue:

- [x] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases (33) covering invalid input, unannounced year, weekend compensation, `addWorkingDays` n = 0 and negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [x] Only existing behaviour is asserted; no bug found, so nothing to report
- [x] `packages/core/data/*.json` not edited
- [x] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass

## Checklist

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat|fix|docs|data|test|refactor|perf|build|ci|chore(scope): …`)
- [x] Tests added or updated (golden test for every bug fix)
- [x] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm format:check` pass locally
- [x] Core stays offline (no `fetch`/HTTP in `packages/core`)
- [x] Data changes go through `scripts/build-data.ts` and `SOURCES.md` (source + license)
- [x] SKILL.md / README updated if behaviour changed

The last three boxes are ticked because they do not apply: only a test file was added. The golden-test item is also not applicable, since this is not a bug fix.
issues.repro_notes: Issue asks for a characterization test file for existing behaviour; such tests pass on base, so no failing test can be written for the right reason. Left unchanged.

issues.title: vn-pit: personal income tax calculator (needs a legal source first)
issues.body:
## Problem
ROADMAP RM-015 is still `idea`. A PIT calculator needs the current brackets, personal and dependant deduction amounts, insurance rates and effective dates. None of these are in the repository.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The maintainer cites the legal source and effective dates in this issue
- [ ] Then: core function + CLI command + MCP tool + `skills/vn-pit/SKILL.md` with Vietnamese trigger words + >= 20 tests in `tests/vn-pit.test.ts` + an entry in `tests/skills.test.ts`
- [ ] Rates live in a data file with a source URL, not in code
issues.triage_reason: The issue cites no legal source for PIT brackets, deductions, insurance rates or effective dates, and the repo has none. Rates would also belong in packages/core/data/, which the bot cannot edit. The maintainer must supply a source first.
issues.skip_reason: triage: not feasible: The issue cites no legal source for PIT brackets, deductions, insurance rates or effective dates, and the repo has none. Rates would also belong in packages/core/data/, which the bot cannot edit. The maintainer must supply a source first.
issues.repro_notes: RM-015 vn-pit needs a legal source (brackets, deductions, insurance rates, effective dates) that is not in the repo and not cited in the issue. Any expected values would be invented, so no test was written.

issues.title: mcp: add a vietqr_decode tool matching the CLI `vietqr decode`
issues.body:
## Problem
RM-024 added `vn-skills vietqr decode <image>` to the CLI (`packages/cli/src/commands/vietqr.ts`). `packages/mcp/src/server.ts` registers `vietqr_build`, `vietqr_parse` and `vietqr_banks` but has no tool that decodes a QR image. MCP clients therefore cannot do what the CLI and skill can, and the README tool list has no such entry.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the test first in `tests/mcp.test.ts`: it calls `vietqr_decode` and fails on the base because the tool does not exist.
- [ ] Add a `vietqr_decode` tool in `packages/mcp/src/server.ts` that takes an image file path, reuses the CLI decode logic (share it rather than duplicate it), and returns the parsed fields.
- [ ] An image with no QR returns the same structured error as the CLI.
- [ ] Add a round-trip test: a PNG built by `vietqr_build` with `out`, then `vietqr_decode`, gives the same fields.
- [ ] Add the tool to the README tool list and to `README.vi.md` if it lists tools.
- [ ] Mention the tool in `skills/vietqr/SKILL.md` if the MCP tools are listed there.
- [ ] `pnpm format`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm exec vitest run` all pass.
issues.triage_reason: The CLI has `vietqr decode` but the MCP server registers no matching tool. I did not read the CLI decode code, so check that the decode logic can be shared before approving.
issues.skip_reason: coder gave up: Cannot implement vietqr_decode the way the reviewer requires. Sharing the decode logic through a proper package dependency needs package.json dependency changes in packages/mcp (jsqr, pngjs or @vn-skills/cli), which require pnpm-lock.yaml updates. The gate forbids lockfile and dependency changes. Maintainer must allow a lockfile update or choose the sharing approach. Working tree reverted to the base apart from the provided test.
issues.feedback:
Attempt 1:
Reviewer rejected:
- packages/mcp/src/server.ts imports '../../cli/src/qrdecode.js' across package boundaries and needed rootDir/include hacks in packages/mcp/tsconfig.json. Share the decode logic through a proper package dependency (for example a workspace package or a declared dependency) instead of a relative path into another package's src.
- jsqr and pngjs are only declared in packages/cli/package.json, so the MCP package uses them without declaring them. Declare them in packages/mcp/package.json or share them through a proper package.
- The new 'out' option on vietqr_build was not requested in the issue. It is an unrequested public API change. QRCode.toFile is unguarded, so an unwritable path throws an unstructured error and no test covers it. Handle the failure with a structured error and test it.
- The global createRequire banner added to packages/mcp/tsup.config.ts is a risky workaround. It could collide with other bundled 'require' declarations. Avoid it, for example by externalising the dependencies.
issues.summary: Added vietqr_decode MCP tool reusing shared decodeQrPng (moved to packages/cli/src/qrdecode.ts, used by CLI too); added optional `out` PNG file output to vietqr_build for the round-trip; fixed mcp bundling (tsconfig rootDir/include, tsup require shim for pngjs); updated README.md and README.vi.md tool lists.
issues.repro_notes: Added vietqr_decode to the expected tool list, plus a round-trip test (vietqr_build with out, then vietqr_decode) and a NO_QR error test. All three fail on the base because the vietqr_decode tool and the vietqr_build `out` option do not exist. Parameter names `out` and `image` were chosen to match the issue and the CLI.

proposals.title: test(vn-holidays): add tests/holidays.test.ts with edge cases beyond the golden fixtures
proposals.body:
## Problem
`vn-holidays` has only `tests/holidays-golden.test.ts` (4 `it` blocks that iterate `tests/golden/vn-holidays.json`). Every other skill has a dedicated `tests/<name>.test.ts`, and CONTRIBUTING requires one. Behaviour that is not a pure input->output case is untested: error results for malformed dates, `announced: false` for years without data, `addWorkingDays` with n=0 or a negative n, and ranges that cross a year boundary.

## Acceptance
- [ ] New `tests/holidays.test.ts` with >= 20 cases covering: invalid date input (`ok: false` with code and hint), a year with no announcement (`announced: false`, statutory days only), weekend-collision compensation, `addWorkingDays` with n = 0 and with a negative n, and a year-boundary crossing
- [ ] Only assert behaviour the current implementation already has. If a case exposes a bug, report it in the PR instead of silently changing behaviour
- [ ] Do not edit `packages/core/data/*.json`
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm format:check` pass
proposals.rationale: The holidays skill has no dedicated test file, unlike the other skills, and CONTRIBUTING requires >= 20 tests per skill.

proposals.title: vn-pit: personal income tax calculator (needs a legal source first)
proposals.body:
## Problem
ROADMAP RM-015 is still `idea`. A PIT calculator needs the current brackets, personal and dependant deduction amounts, insurance rates and effective dates. None of these are in the repository.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The maintainer cites the legal source and effective dates in this issue
- [ ] Then: core function + CLI command + MCP tool + `skills/vn-pit/SKILL.md` with Vietnamese trigger words + >= 20 tests in `tests/vn-pit.test.ts` + an entry in `tests/skills.test.ts`
- [ ] Rates live in a data file with a source URL, not in code
proposals.rationale: [needs a person] RM-015 has no open issue. It cannot be implemented without a legal source that only the maintainer can supply.

proposals.title: mcp: add a vietqr_decode tool matching the CLI `vietqr decode`
proposals.body:
## Problem
RM-024 added `vn-skills vietqr decode <image>` to the CLI (`packages/cli/src/commands/vietqr.ts`). `packages/mcp/src/server.ts` registers `vietqr_build`, `vietqr_parse` and `vietqr_banks` but has no tool that decodes a QR image. MCP clients therefore cannot do what the CLI and skill can, and the README tool list has no such entry.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Write the test first in `tests/mcp.test.ts`: it calls `vietqr_decode` and fails on the base because the tool does not exist.
- [ ] Add a `vietqr_decode` tool in `packages/mcp/src/server.ts` that takes an image file path, reuses the CLI decode logic (share it rather than duplicate it), and returns the parsed fields.
- [ ] An image with no QR returns the same structured error as the CLI.
- [ ] Add a round-trip test: a PNG built by `vietqr_build` with `out`, then `vietqr_decode`, gives the same fields.
- [ ] Add the tool to the README tool list and to `README.vi.md` if it lists tools.
- [ ] Mention the tool in `skills/vietqr/SKILL.md` if the MCP tools are listed there.
- [ ] `pnpm format`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm exec vitest run` all pass.
proposals.rationale: The CLI has `vietqr decode` but the MCP server registers no matching tool. I did not read the CLI decode code, so check that the decode logic can be shared before approving.

proposals.title: docs: add a 5-minute quickstart with copy-paste examples for each skill
proposals.body:
## Problem
The README has a `<!-- TODO: GIF -->` placeholder and no short path from install to a first working result. Install steps are spread across the Skills, Install, MCP and Library sections. A newcomer cannot try the project in five minutes.

## Acceptance
- [ ] New `docs/quickstart.md` with three paths: CLI via `npx -y @vn-skills/cli`, MCP via `claude mcp add`, and the library via `npm i @vn-skills/core`.
- [ ] Each path has one copy-paste command and the exact expected output, taken by running the command (no invented values).
- [ ] A short section on `vn-skills install all --agent claude|cursor|codex`.
- [ ] The README links to the quickstart near the top.
- [ ] `README.vi.md` gets the same link and a matching Vietnamese quickstart, `docs/quickstart.vi.md`.
- [ ] The existing readme tests still pass.
proposals.rationale: The project has 0 stars and only bot-level downloads. The first five minutes of use are the biggest adoption lever, and the README has no demo.

proposals.title: docs: list vn-skills in MCP registries and Agent Skills directories
proposals.body:
## Task (a person does this)
- [ ] Check that `@vn-skills/mcp` has a clear npm description and keywords: `mcp`, `vietnam`, `vietqr`.
- [ ] Submit the server to the official MCP registry and to popular community MCP lists.
- [ ] Submit the skills folder to Agent Skills directories and awesome-lists, including Vietnamese developer communities.
- [ ] Record each link in the issue as it is done.

The tool list in the README is the text to use for the submissions.
proposals.rationale: [needs you] There are no stars and no outside discovery. Listings are the cheapest way to reach people who search for VN-specific agent tools.

kv.value: The repo has broad skill coverage and release hygiene, but no outside adoption. The proposals focus on a quickstart, closing the MCP decode gap, and getting listed in registries.
